typen.name: CustomFieldValues
typen.beschreibung: A flat object of custom field values: text, numbers, true/false, a list of texts, or null.

typen.name: DateTime
typen.beschreibung: A date-time string at UTC, such as 2019-12-03T09:54:33Z, compliant with the date-time format.

typen.name: SavedViewColumns
typen.beschreibung: The column keys a list shows, in order.

typen.name: SavedViewFilters
typen.beschreibung: A list of custom field comparisons: { key, operator, value? } entries.
